_comment: Training schema modeled on the NWCG Event geodatabase (Event Point / Event Line / Event Polygon).

_authoritative_source.note: The blank Event GDB shipped inside the GeoOps Incident Directory Structure is the authority. If you have it, USE IT and treat this file as documentation only. This file exists so the validator and the mock-data generator have something to check against before anyone has downloaded the template, and so a Python-only box can lint the exercise data.

_domain_verification.note: FeatureCategory domains are revised annually. Verify this list against the PMS 936 symbology pages before you finalize a legend or print a key.

common_fields.name: FeatureCategory
common_fields.description: Drives symbology. This is the field the .lyrx renders on. Get it wrong and the feature draws as a grey dot.

common_fields.name: IsVisible
common_fields.description: No hides the feature without deleting it. Use this, not deletion, when a drop point goes cold.

common_fields.name: MapMethod
common_fields.description: How the geometry was captured. Feeds the source statement.

common_fields.name: GeometryID
common_fields.description: Stable per-feature identifier that survives an edit session.

common_fields.name: IRWINID
common_fields.description: MUST stay null on an exercise. Populated only by the real IRWIN integration.

extra_fields.name: LengthMiles
extra_fields.description: Recalculate after every edit session. Ops reads line mileage off this.

extra_fields.name: GISAcres
extra_fields.description: Calculated from geometry in an equal-area or UTM projection. NEVER hand-typed — the acreage on the map and the acreage in the 209 have to come from the same place.

extra_fields.name: PolygonDateTime
extra_fields.description: When this perimeter was collected. Drives the progression map's date symbology.

rules: Do not add, rename, or retype fields in the three Event feature classes. Downstream tools and the .lyrx files bind to these names.
Symbolize on FeatureCategory only. If a feature draws wrong, the attribute is wrong — do not fix it by overriding the symbol.

Where an Event Line (dozer/hand line) sits on top of the perimeter, suppress the perimeter polygon's outline so the line reads cleanly. This is a display fix on the polygon layer, not an edit to the geometry.
Recalculate GISAcres and LengthMiles at the end of every edit session, before export.
IRWINID stays null for the duration of the exercise.
